overall.headline: Global EFB and Flight Planning Adoption Analysis
observations: Across **519** total airlines, **127** record EFB selections and **68** record flight planning selections.
Flag carriers frequently utilize **In-house built** solutions and **AvioBook**, whereas low-cost carriers lean toward specialized third-party tools like **Navblue Mission+**.
For flight planning, **Lido** leads with **24** of **68** recorded selections, followed by **NavBlue** with **16**.
overall.caveat: Counts represent recorded selections rather than absolute market share, and missing fields reflect unrecorded data rather than non-adoption.

regions.name: Europe & Central Asia
regions.headline: European Market Favors In-House and AvioBook Solutions
observations: Out of **151** airlines, **35** record EFB selections and **14** record flight planning selections.
European flag carriers across various fleet sizes demonstrate higher rates of **In-house built** and **AvioBook** adoption compared to other regional averages.
For flight planning, **5** of **14** planning-recorded airlines select **Lido**, aligning closely with global proportional trends.
regions.caveat: Regional insights rely strictly on aggregated Airtable counts and multi-select entries; unrecorded data points remain unknown.

regions.name: East Asia & Pacific
regions.headline: Strong Demand for NavBlue and Lido in East Asia
observations: Among **130** airlines, **39** have recorded EFB data and **18** record flight planning choices.
Flag carriers with medium fleets (**51–150** fleet size) show diverse EFB usage including **3** of **8** utilizing **In-house built** systems.
Planning selection rates show **9** of **18** opting for **NavBlue**, exceeding the overall relative baseline.
regions.caveat: Analysis excludes unrecorded carriers; metrics reflect selections logged in the dataset, not full market penetration.

regions.name: North America
regions.headline: FlightKeys Dominates North American Planning Selections
observations: From **59** regional airlines, **14** record EFB selections and **9** record flight planning tools.
Low-cost carriers with large fleets feature **2** of **2** recording **AvioBook** usage for EFB operations.
Flight planning shows heavy concentration with **5** of **9** planning-recorded airlines selecting **FlightKeys**.
regions.caveat: Low field-recording rates require cautious interpretation; missing values should not be construed as lack of technology use.

regions.name: Latin America & Caribbean
regions.headline: Balanced EFB Distribution with Lido Leading Planning
observations: Out of **56** airlines, **12** record EFB choices and **9** record flight planning selections.
Flag carriers and low-cost carriers split EFB preferences across **AvioBook**, **Flightman**, and **Paper**.
For flight planning, **4** of **9** planning-recorded airlines list **Lido**, maintaining a strong regional footprint.
regions.caveat: Aggregated counts may double-count airlines due to multi-select fields, and unmapped attributes are excluded.

regions.name: Middle East & North Africa
regions.headline: Diversified EFB Vendor Adoption Across Middle Eastern Carriers
observations: In a pool of **51** airlines, **15** record EFB selections and **10** record flight planning preferences.
Large flag carriers show notable adoption of **Jeppesen Aviator** (**2** of **3** EFB-recorded airlines).
Flight planning selections split evenly, with **3** of **10** recording **Lido** and **3** of **10** recording **NavBlue**.
regions.caveat: Conclusions are bound strictly to the provided aggregate counts; missing inputs are omitted from calculations.

regions.name: Sub-Saharan Africa
regions.headline: Emerging EFB Tool Adoption with Limited Field Coverage
observations: Out of **47** regional airlines, **8** record EFB data and **4** record flight planning tools.
Small flag carriers show scattered adoption across **AvioBook**, **Jeppesen Aviator**, and **SITA Flight Folder**.
Flight planning is led by **Lido** with **2** of **4** planning selections.
regions.caveat: Low sample sizes in recorded fields necessitate caution against broad market generalizations.

regions.name: South Asia
regions.headline: Compact Regional Sample Highlights Lido and NavBlue
observations: From **13** total airlines, **4** record EFB selections and **4** record flight planning selections.
Small flag carriers divide their EFB choices between **Navblue Mission+** and **Paper**.
For flight planning, **2** of **4** planning-recorded airlines choose **Lido**.
regions.caveat: Extremely small sample sizes limit comparative statistical reliability; unrecorded fields remain unknown.

regions.name: Unmapped
regions.headline: Unassigned Regional Data Records No Selections
observations: Among **12** unmapped airlines, **0** record EFB selections and **0** record flight planning selections.
No carrier segment data is available for analysis in this category.
No vendor selection rates can be computed due to complete absence of recorded metrics.
regions.caveat: Zero counts indicate a lack of recorded data rather than verified absence of technology.
